items.title: Arqus GmbH (i.G.) / Arqus Aerospace
items.summary: Arqus (Munich, trading as Arqus Aerospace , company still in formation) is a directed-energy startup pairing autonomous edge-AI tracking modules with high-precision laser effectors. The terrestrial application is defeat of drone swarms and protection of military installations; a second application targets optical threats in orbit.
